name: E16 Payroll Procedures
rows: Clauses PAY-1 to PAY-6; Appendix A, accounts used for payroll
Frozen evidence from this run. Clause text is copied word for word.

Each payroll register is booked from Brookline's journal: field crews to 1400 Construction in Progress, job 27-05, cost code 01-100, and office and site management to 6000 Salaries & Wages, at total cost. The funding debit on the bank statement must equal the register's total cost, and 2130, 2140, 2145 and 2190 must clear to zero once the funding is booked.

When an employee leaves, the payroll lead end-dates the employee in Brookline before the next payroll is processed. Final pay covers work through the last day worked. Any pay after that date is an overpayment and is recovered.

Hourly employees are paid 1.5 times their straight-time rate for hours over 40 in a workweek, as the union wage and fringe schedule requires. An underpayment is corrected on the next payroll and accrued at month-end.

Brookline withholds and deposits federal income tax, social security and Medicare, employee and employer shares, on the semiweekly schedule, and holds the Washington premiums for the quarterly return. The tax liability report must equal the registers to the cent.

Union dues and the employer's fringe contributions are remitted to the trust each month; 401(k) deferrals within three business days of each pay date. Each garnishment is remitted to the agency within seven business days after the pay date, as the order requires. Amounts withheld and not remitted are a liability until they are paid.

The Controller reviews this reconciliation and every proposed entry. Entries are posted only after that review, by the person who posts journal entries, and payroll corrections are made in Brookline by the payroll lead.
